gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
I saw him ___ the wall and disappear into the garden.
gaps.explanation: see/hear + object + bare infinitive = the complete action; -ing = the action in progress. Both readings possible here; the bare infinitive is expected.

gaps.sentence: We stopped at a village ___ some lunch.
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do something: stopped to have lunch.

gaps.sentence: She was the first woman ___ the peak in winter.
gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: Would you like ___ now or later?
gaps.explanation: would like takes the to-infinitive: would like to eat.
deny + -ing or having + past participle: denied doing/having done. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.
